name: Can I stay in my home during a primary suite addition?

mainEntity.name: Can I stay in my home during a primary suite addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you can stay in your home during a primary suite addition depends on the project's scope and the extent of disruption. If the addition is on a separate wing or level, and essential utilities remain functional, it might be possible. However, if the work involves significant demolition, utility shutdowns, or impacts structural integrity near living areas, temporary relocation might be necessary for safety and comfort. Your contractor can advise on the best approach for your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Staying home during an addition depends on the project's scope and disruption; significant demolition or utility shutdowns may require temporary relocation.
